messages:
marta (support): FYI — customer acme-corp hit a 401 when calling our erasure API. They need proof of deletion and KMS/HSM evidence for a DPA request. Can we triage? Repro below.

marta (support): ```
# repro (redacted)
curl -X DELETE "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/acme-tenant-42/data" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <client-token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"

Response: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_client","message":"token verification failed"}
```

alex (eng): can you paste the x-request-id for the failing call and tenant id? also include the masked Authorization header. 401 often means token scope/mismatch but could be CMK/HSM policy related.

marta (support): x-request-id: 01H8XK7YQ2 (truncated). tenant: acme-tenant-42. Header: Authorization: Bearer ******** (client). Customer says they rotated keys on 2025-02-10T21:05Z. They insist erasure must be completed and evidence provided.

priya (security): we'll need: 1) audit log export for acme-tenant-42 around 2025-02-10T20:50 -> 2025-02-10T21:20Z; 2) KMS key metadata (key_id, creation_ts, last_rotation_ts, origin); 3) HSM attestation document if they request proof of key access/destruction. I'll draft DPA-safe wording for the response.

ethan (sre): grabbing auth + gateway traces and KMS key usage logs now. If token validated upstream but DELETE failed, check auth-service -> kms signature check. ETA ~45m. tagging @audit-bot to run an export for the time window.

audit-bot: export job queued. export_id=exp-20250210-acme-01. Destination: s3://redwood-exports/exp-20250210-acme-01.tar.gz (access restricted). Includes: audit entries, request traces, key-usage events, and HSM operation logs for key ids seen in that window.

alex (eng): quick troubleshooting tip: try repro with an admin token (scope: admin:erase) to confirm whether it's a token-scope issue vs key policy. Also check tenant CMK policy — if the customer re-imported a key or changed key-id in their config, verification can fail even if they kept the same alias.

marta (support): acknowledged. I'll tell the customer we've started the export and will provide a packaged bundle + attestation within 4 hours. Priya — can you confirm legal-safe attestation text before I send? :pray:

priya (security): will prepare attestation + redaction checklist. We'll need a signed HSM cert from the vendor to attach. Adding vendor request now; will post the draft once ready.
